domain_guidance.summary: This domain expertly covers core data integration principles utilizing the advanced Celonis platform to successfully prepare enterprise data for subsequent analytical processes and reporting workflows during regular operations.

This domain carefully focuses on connecting securely to external systems of record in order to capture operational data trails effectively across your organization's complex IT landscape and database environments.

This domain specifically involves extracting event log data and raw transactional trails directly from various source information systems for downstream analytical ingestion and subsequent process mining applications deployed across enterprise environments.

This domain deals with transforming raw extracted event logs into clean, structured information that is entirely suitable for advanced process analysis and sophisticated business modeling tasks executed by data engineering teams daily.

This domain covers loading processed data accurately into designated target structures to feed downstream analytics, executive dashboards, and complex process mining models designed for extensive enterprise performance monitoring and continuous business optimization.

This domain centers on managing and validating active data pipelines continuously to maintain high data integrity and reliability over extended operational periods within enterprise information systems and modern cloud architectures.

This domain focuses heavily on building multi-process object-centric data models that map complex relationships between various business objects and corresponding operational events across multiple organizational systems to support advanced process mining initiatives.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Ensure you complete your 60 questions within the 100-minute time limit. Manage your time carefully across all domains and review your pipeline integration knowledge before starting.

faq.answer_text: The certification exam consists of exactly 60 questions covering seven specific domains related to Celonis data integration and object-centric data modeling for all registered candidates who want to prove their professional data engineering skills.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The minimum passing score required to successfully pass the examination is 63 percent of the available points on the test administered by Celonis for all candidates seeking certification status.

The maximum time allowed for completing all sections of the certification exam is precisely 100 minutes from start to finish under standard testing conditions provided by the official testing administrator platform.

The certification remains valid for 1.5 years, after which you should check with Celonis for the current certification path and any applicable renewal options or continuing education requirements available.
faq.question_title: What is the validity period of the certification?

editorial.overview: The official certification exam evaluates your technical ability to use Celonis Data Integration tools to successfully build, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise-grade data pipelines. Certified by Celonis, this demanding 100-minute test features exactly 60 questions covering data integration, system connections, extraction, transformation, loading, pipeline management, and object-centric data models for modern organizations.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official guidance on preparing for the certification exam and complete all of the required training courses provided by Celonis. Spend substantial time gaining practical hands-on experience with Celonis Data Integration, focusing closely on system connections, data extraction, complex transformations, loading processes, and building object-centric data models.
editorial.who_should_take: Users with six months or more of hands-on experience with Celonis Data Integration should take this exam. Customer and partner users aiming to officially prove their expertise can register through the official certification program.
